# CarouselVane (ColorLib Carousel 16) — Tasks & Design Notes

## Source Reference

- **Source Template:** ColorLib Carousel V16 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-16/`)
- **Preview URL:** `https://carousel-vane.free.componentdock.com`
- **Category:** Feedback / Testimonials Carousel

## Structure Order

1. **Header / Navigation**: Minimal brand logo, navigation links (Home, Testimonials, About, Contact).
2. **Hero / Introduction Section**: Title ("What Our Customers Say"), subtitle introducing the feedback showcase.
3. **Testimonial Carousel Section**: Interactive carousel wrapper with testimonial cards (Avatar image, Customer Name & Role, Star Rating, Testimonial Quote/Feedback).
4. **Interactive Controls**: Previous/Next chevron buttons and clickable pagination dots.
5. **Footer**: Copyright, quick links, and mandatory "Component Dock" link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- Clean minimalist white/light-gray background (`bg-slate-50`).
- Card design: crisp white cards with soft shadows (`bg-white shadow-sm rounded-xl p-8`).
- Typography: high-contrast dark text (`text-slate-800`) for review headings and body (`text-slate-600`).
- No ColorLib branding in app code; provenance lives only in this spec and TEMPLATES.md.
